_note: N11e is diagnostics-only: it carries the sealed-loader failure detail out in WlscplLoadResultV1 and prints it in the HOST (the only channel that survives the sealed-child ns; R3 proved in-loader HiLogPrint AND stderr are both silent). The N11e build KEEPS the :333 dlsym(HiLogPrint)==NULL gate but records it as fail branch=4 (EMIT_RESOLVE); removal is deferred to N11f, so N11e changes no load behaviour. N11f prints an UNCONDITIONAL host line '[N11e-PROBE] done stage=.. branch=.. index=..' after the provider load returns (success too), so a non-fatal branch (4 EMIT_RESOLVE / 6 OWNER_PUBLISH_LATE) recorded in the result struct still surfaces on a successful load. That done line is the registered smoke marker (retro-20) AND the branch carrier; the failure-only line '[N11e-PROBE] fail ...' remains for the abort path. Loader-stage stderr does NOT reach hilog, so the struct read by the host is the only carrier.
